annotations.title: Skip, retry, unschedule, retitle or move a queue item

description:
[PUBLISHES to social accounts · `publish` scope] `action`: "skip" passes over a queued item; "retry" puts a failed/skipped item back in line; "unschedule" deletes a booked platform post and puts the item back in line. Also `youtubeTitle`, per-item `platforms`, and `position` (0-based among waiting items). Needs the `publish` scope (or admin) on the Agency plan or higher.
(Wraps PATCH /api/v2/queues/{id}/items/{itemId}.)

platforms.description: This item's own platforms, used when it is booked; null → back to the queue's. Only before the item is booked (queued / failed / skipped).

youtubeTitle.description: null or "" → back to the draft's stored title.
